title: Sormano and de Vaulx to François I, Ferrara, February 1529, BnF fr. 3096 nos. 63, 65, 66

plaintext.source: No decipherment; the duplicate no. 66 writes much of the same matter in clear.

transcription.source: Gallica btv1b9060015d; glyph segmentation, clustering, k-NN, every line checked by eye
transcription.notes: Transcription records decoded letters, not sign labels, so no count can be measured; 18,273 signs were segmented across the three letters (README).

plaintext.source: No decipherment; no. 65 writes some of the same matter in clear.

transcription.notes: Breaks off at the foot of f. 116v; final leaf not located.

system.summary: Homophonic substitution on symbols with special signs for cc and ll, a null, and a double-circle nomenclator sign for duca.
system.sibling_key: Lasry's 2023 key (published on Cryptiana), verified on the glossed control no. 62 (f. 113) and no. 67; used.
system.notes: Corrections proved on the leaves: crossbarred long-s = e, a tall looped null, double circle = duca, ꝓ = d.

prior_solution.where: Lasry's 2023 key on Cryptiana (Tomokiyo); no reading of these letters. Lasry notes the same cipher in BnF fr. 3045 f. 28 and fr. 3034 f. 154.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Checked Lasry's key against the interlinear decipherment of control no. 62.
Segmented, clustered, hand-labelled and k-NN-classified the glyphs; checked every line by eye.
Applied the key; found a null, crossbarred long-s = e and the duca sign on the leaves.
Aligned nos. 65 and 66, which encipher different passages, as a mutual crib.
Read nos. 65 and 66 in full and no. 63 as far as its leaves go.

Contribution re-assessed on Lasry's note (21 Sept 2026): the key serves the whole volume, and checking for a shared key within one collection is standard, so this is not a key found elsewhere. The main achievement is transcription. The same cipher is in fr. 3045 f. 28 and fr. 3034 f. 154 (not read here).

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's 2023 key for BnF fr. 3096 (on Tomokiyo's cryptiana) was verified against the interlinear decipherment of no. 62 and applied to nos. 63, 65 and 66 after a full glyph transcription; nos. 65 and 66 encipher different passages and served as mutual cribs.
